items.title: Tech stocks today: AI warnings send shock through chip stocks
items.summary: Tech stock news for the week of Sept. 14.

items.title: Elon Musk: I've been 'sounding the alarm' on AI for a while
items.summary: Leave it to Elon Musk to say, essentially, I've been right all along.

items.title: Anthropic, OpenAI now want to tame the rapid pace of AI development
items.summary: Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) CEO Dario Amodei and OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) CEO Sam Altman are in agreement that the AI industry needs to pace its development. Yahoo Finance's Jake Conley and Pras Subramanian are joined by Business Insider Today executive editor Dan DeFrancesco to discuss the two business leaders' latest statements and what these sentiments may ultimately mean for the AI frontier.

items.title: Can Palantir Deploy Fast Enough To Move Its Stock Higher?
items.summary: Palantir Technologies (PLTR) stock has gained about 28% over the past three months, against under 4% for the S&P 500, and it still trades roughly 19% below its 52-week high. Over the past twelve months it has returned almost nothing. What could move it from here is work Palantir has already sold and has not yet delivered.

items.title: The Winners and Losers in an AI Slowdown
items.summary: Alphabet, Meta Platforms and other AI labs would benefit from a development slowdown: they could possibly catch up to OpenAI and Anthropic.

items.title: Whoever Spends Smarter Wins the Microsoft-Alphabet Cloud Fight. Here Is Who Is Ahead.
items.summary: Microsoft and Alphabet both posted monster cloud quarters and both are spending at a pace that would have seemed reckless two years ago, but only one of them is funding the buildout without going to the debt markets, and that gap may define the trade for 2027.

items.title: ‘They Don’t Call It an Extra Value Meal for Nothing’: McDonald’s Pitches $8 Big Macs as Diesel Hits $6.23
items.summary: McDonald's is slashing Big Mac meal prices to lure back customers at the same moment diesel costs shatter records, leaving franchisees caught between a value-hungry public and a supply chain bleeding money at every mile.

items.title: AI doomsday warnings collide with a $7 trillion spending boom
items.summary: AI leaders are asking for caution just as the industry's infrastructure bill keeps climbing.
